acceptanceCriteria: Each item is delivered, or declined with a recorded reason.
Repeated retire/compact/export on a sealed store is tested.
Owner decision recorded on the non-terminal carry rule.
body: V1-1618 (PR #1074, JRT-V0-001..014) residuals: (1) export, compaction and import refuse on a sealed store and CLI archive restore is unimplemented, so retire is one-shot; (2) a sealed store has no checkpoint route, ReviewFold refolds from S each tick; (3) handoff policies, review submissions, artifacts and admits before S are not seeded, so a later receipt naming one refuses, and replaying a retired request ID returns UNSUPPORTED; (4) a consistently forged seal is detectable only against the archive; (5) non-terminal tickets are carried by value in the seal, owner may prefer an all-terminal rule; (6) REDO_PENDING refusal untested, seal not charged to capacity; (7) doctor journal key additive to TQD-V0-001 field list. Review-round findings are handled in the #1074 fix round, not here.
title: journal retention follow-ups: retire is one-shot, sealed store has no checkpoint route, pre-seal objects not seeded (V1-1618 residuals)
